That makes sense — this is heavy-lift work and you've made real progress getting the skeleton in place.

A couple of quick thoughts before you step away:

- **Save the skeleton now** so you have it fresh when you come back.
- **When you're ready to pick back up**, the highest-value next step is drafting **Section 2 (Statement of Need)** and **Section 4 (Program Design)** — they carry 60% of your score.
- **In the meantime**, if you can have someone pull the data sources and letters of support, that keeps things moving without needing your brain power.

Get some rest. When you're back, just tell me which section you want to draft first and I'll walk you through it.
